annotations.title: Change the closing date, the questions, or what people may send.

description: Changes the settings the organiser can change on the site: the day collecting stops, the questions people are asked, whether they may send voice, video or writing, and which one the button offers first. Nobody is told about a change.

answer_with.description: Any of voice, video and written.

closes_on.description: The day collecting stops, as a date. It means stop collecting rather than finished.

lead_with.description: Which one the big button offers first.

questions.description: The questions people are asked, up to twelve.
